chapter: Becoming a musician: ukulele, clarinet and the Boozaire Kings
title: Buddy Petit goes to Chicago and the Tennessee Ten
summary: Danny recalls Buddy Petit going to Chicago with King Oliver and then the Tennessee Ten vaudeville act.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: ...Petit, Buddy Petit... See he goes off, and he's with... He goes to Chicago and he's with King Oliver. Gee whiz! Then he leaves King Oliver and he goes with the Tennessee Ten. I didn't know what the hell they was talking about. I found out later that was one of the best vaudeville acts that ever happened, the Tennessee Ten. You know about them.
I've heard the name. I didn't see them.
